subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Context-free calculations to 5
source.subtopic: Addition and subtraction and number bonds up to 3 (weeks 1-4), up to 4 (weeks 5-6) and up to 5 (weeks 7-10)

show.line: Five fingers on one hand! Two up and three down. Two plus three equals five.

rounds.prompt: Four red beads and one blue bead. How many altogether?
rounds.praise: Five! Four plus one equals five.

rounds.prompt: Three plus one. Tap the answer.
Five take away two. How many are left? Say the number.
Two plus two. Tap the answer.
rounds.praise: Two plus two equals four. A double!

rounds.prompt: Five equals one plus what? Tap the missing number.

rounds.story: Five ducks swim on the pond. Three fly away. How many ducks are left?
rounds.praise: Two ducks! Five take away three is two.

rounds.prompt: Does it make five? Put each sum in its group.

hints: Use your fingers. Put some up, count them all.
Take away means hide some fingers. Count the ones still up.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Three plus two equals five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's use fingers. Three, and two more. Four, five!

parent_line: Can add and take away with numbers up to 5 and knows the bonds of 5.
